subject: Renewal + Expansion recap: usage review, pain points, next steps

Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:00:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal + Expansion recap: usage review, pain points, next steps

Tom / Sophie —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + next steps so we’re aligned as you move toward renewal: 

Summary of what we heard
- Current usage: ~50M tokens/month (Q2 average); peak windows during batch report generation (~1.8k concurrent reqs)
- Pain points: latency spikes during peaks (95p latency ~1.2s), frequent model mismatches on clinical categorization, high per-token costs for embedding-based search proofs
- Goals: reduce latency by 30% at peak, lower cost per 1k tokens by ~25%, pilot embeddings for search & semantic retrieval, explore Dedicated or Private deployment for PHI workflows

Proposed expansion path / timeline
- Short term (next 2–4 weeks): pilot Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + KV caching) on hosted infra; measure latency/cost delta
- Mid term (4–8 weeks): proposal for Dedicated pool sizing (reserved GPUs) + SLO targets for renewal negotiation
- Procurement / renewal: target signing before 2027-08-15 to avoid month-to-month pricing exposure

Action items
- Marissa (me): share Q2 usage report and updated proposal (attaching usage CSV + proposal v2) — by EOD 6/15 (attached)
- Tom: confirm procurement timeline and security contact for SOC2/infra review
- Michael: scope pricing for Dedicated + a pilot estimate; prep SE handoff call the week of 6/21

Attachments: nimbus_usage_q2_2027.csv, redwood_proposal_v2.pdf

Thanks — happy to sync live if it’s easier.

Best,
